'''Mutates''' were a type of [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sith-spawned]] [[mutant]]s [[Sith alchemy/Legends|engineered]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Malakite]]. They were used as troops of his realm, [[the Menagerie]]. They consisted of a wide variety of sentient [[Species/Legends|species]] including [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]], and [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] but were distinguished by their red hue. They were lightly armed and wore a mixture of armor and primitive loinclothes. Members of the Mutates also used primitive pre-industrial weapons, reflecting Malakite's hatred of technology.

Mutates saw action against [[Odionate]] forces during [[Capture of Skarpos|first]] and [[Massacre on Skarpos|second battles]] of [[Skarpos]].
